messages:
Kira (Growth): Quick check  launching the webinar promo next week. Need two X microthreads (4 tweets each) + 1 LinkedIn short post. Variant X1 = 'benchmarks + quick chart', Variant X2 = 'engineer story + quote'. Test CTAs: Register vs Watch recording. Also planning a tiny paid test (USD 300) to boost the winning variant. Who volunteers for assets + reply scripts?

Ben (Social): I'll run the queues and the paid test. Proposed publish plan (UTC): X1 2026-04-08T15:00Z, LinkedIn short 2026-04-09T18:00Z, X2 2026-04-10T15:00Z. Will pin a top reply with reg link for 48h and set two manual follow-ups inside 24h. Shortlink for tracking: rdw.ai/launch0426.

Asha (Content): I'll write both microthreads + LinkedIn copy and three reply templates (info, technical, sales). Upload ETA: 2026-04-01 14:00 PT to /Marketing/Events/webinar-apr-2026/assets. Assets will include hero_1200x628.png, clip20s_v1.mp4 (silent), and gif_snip_v1.gif. Note: keeping music-free to avoid license delays.

Luca (Partnerships): Heads-up: partner ComputeCo can amplify on 4/09 morning if we send copy + image by 4/02. I'll coordinate. Also have one advocate at AuthPlatform willing to retweet.

Kira (Growth): Routing plan: Zapier -> HubSpot. Pipeline name webinar_social_apr. Intent rules: regex /(pricing|demo|enterprise|trial|rfp)/i -> high; if profile shows company domain or follower_count>600 -> medium. Auto-DM for exact-match demo/pricing keywords: "Thanks! Please DM your work email or register rdw.ai/launch0426 and our SDR will follow up." UTM: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_apr2026&utm_content={variant}.

ops-bot: Reminder: Confirm clip consent and image usage by 2026-04-02. Maintenance window 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC  avoid scheduling. Consent checkbox on reg form: TRUE.

Ben (Social): Engagement play: 1) Pin reg link for 48h, 2) First reply within 3h with extra stat + slide image, 3) Second reply within 24h with CTA to book a demo. I'll create a mute filter for obvious spam. Also will DM internal advocates the exact re-share copy once Asha uploads drafts.

Asha (Content): Reply templates (pick one per scenario): - Low-intent: "Thanks! Register: rdw.ai/launch0426  recording sent to registrants." - Tech Q: "Great Q  we'll cover routing and perf tradeoffs in the demo. Slides: rdw.ai/slides0426" - Sales handoff: "Sounds like a good fit  can our SDR reach out? Please DM your email or register and we'll prioritize follow-up."

Kira (Growth): Regex for Zapier filter (copyable):
```
/(pricing|demo|trial|enterprise|rfp|purchase)/i
```
I'll add a condition that comments with >1 keyword or containing a company domain escalate to highest priority.

Luca (Partnerships): I'll ping partners now and confirm two amplifiers. Will send a short asset pack (PNG + one-line) by 4/02 EOD.

Kira (Growth): Action items: Asha uploads drafts + assets by 4/01 14:00 PT; Ben to queue posts and share Sprout links; Luca to confirm partner amplification; I'll push Zapier mapping and HubSpot stage today. ops-bot to confirm clip/image licenses by 4/02. Quick check 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Thanks :rocket:
